text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Regarding this year's Holy Hoof 
Festival... 
It was suddenly decided that I will 
participate 
in the "Costume Performance Show."
choice_data_list:
Isn't that the event where you act in 
costume?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 
I plan to dress as a fallen dark knight.

A "fallen dark knight." 
It was unimaginable given the upright, 
dignified aura 
she usually carried.
choice_data_list: ...I'm having a hard time picturing it.
...I'm having a hard time picturing it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Well, I imagine so. 
Yet that is precisely why it holds value.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Bizarre and unpredictable. 
My strategy is to subvert classic tropes 
with an unexpected maneuver.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please look forward to the day of the 
event.

The day of the Holy Hoof Festival. Just as 
she suggested, 
I came to watch the "Costume Performance 
Show."

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And that concludes Super Creek's 
mummy performance! Up next is—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Next up is none other than our very own 
"Emperor"! 
President Rudolf's performance! Take it 
away!
choice_data_list: Oh, here she comes!
Ah, here she comes!

text_block_list.text: (SLAM!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Ah... my dearest friend. 
My sworn comrade, who guided and supported 
me above all others.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I believed in you as though you were a 
divine oracle. 
Never once doubting we would guard each 
other's backs for all eternity...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—And to think that in the end, all that 
remained 
was this tranquil void of nothingness...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Detestable... Cursed be the blade that 
tore you away. 
And cursed be the hubris and negligence 
that allowed that blade to strike...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And worse—even your dazzling strength, 
charging ever forward without a single 
thought for yourself...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
... 
Tell me, my friend. I have made my choice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even if my pride should be stained in 
blood. 
Even if my knees sink into the mire of 
treachery and mockery—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—I shall purge all who dare besmirch your 
name with my own two hands.
choice_data_list: (Wait?! Is she looking right at me...?)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is no atonement. 
It is my vengeance upon the world that 
took you away.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Do not stop me. 
If you truly wish to protect me, even now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is—punishment for you, who left me 
behind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...And—that is all.
(—*WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!*)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected of President Rudolf! Truly 
breathtaking! 
A fallen knight performance of sheer 
brilliance, 
befitting the grand finale...!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Let's give her a big round of applause, 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: How was it? My performance, that is.
choice_data_list: It was downright incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. 
Is that so? Then I am most pleased.
choice_data_list: What did you base that acting on?
What inspired your acting?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Inspiration, you say...? I didn't model it 
after 
any particular work, to tell the truth.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has someone dear to them. 
Someone they wish would always stay by 
their side.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, what if someone like that were lost 
due to an error of one's own making...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Picturing such a scenario naturally led me 
to that kind of performance.
choice_data_list: I see... So that was it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 
—However, it is merely an imaginary 
scenario.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In reality, I shall protect what matters 
to the end. 
I will never let it slip away.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Never.

Pierced by Symboli Rudolf's gaze, I 
freeze. 
Scrambling to find something to say...
choice_data_list:
P-Practicing your acting! Must've been 
tough, right?

P-Practicing your acting! Wasn't it really 
tough?
T-That was an imaginary scenario... right?

T-That was an imaginary scenario... wasn't 
it?

text_block_list.text:
Pierced by Symboli Rudolf's gaze, I 
freeze. 
Scrambling to find something to say...

P-Practicing your acting! Must've been 
tough, right?

P-Practicing your acting! Wasn't it really 
tough?

T-That was an imaginary scenario... wasn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That was... 
Well, put simply, an extension of giving a 
speech.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In the sense of standing before people and 
commanding the floor, 
acting and giving a speech are quite 
similar, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Both are acts of conveying heartfelt 
thoughts 
to an audience.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As well as in the fact that how it is 
received 
is left entirely up to the listener.
choice_data_list: T-True enough...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh... 
I can only hope my message came through.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That was... 
Well, put simply, an extension of giving a 
speech.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In the sense of standing before people and 
commanding the floor, 
acting and giving a speech are quite 
similar, wouldn't you say?
choice_data_list: M-Maybe, yeah...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, I could give you acting 
lessons sometime. 
If you are to stand by my side, having 
eloquence would serve you well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What do you think?
choice_data_list: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh, merely a jest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, it is almost time to change 
back. 
...Though, before that, shall we take a 
photo together?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As for the pose... let me see. 
How about back-to-back?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh. 
Yes, of course. Merely an imaginary 
scenario.

Hearing that, I feel a strange sense of 
relief. 
...Yet at the same time, a twinge of 
loneliness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us return to our duties. 
...You will join me, won't you? My dear 
friend.
